PDF CSE 168: Rendering Algorithms
Ray Marching • As a ray passes through a volume, we need to accumulate the changes in radiance along the ray due to emission, absorption, outscattering and in-scattering • As these changes vary along the ray, we need to divide up the ray into finite segments and approximate these values along the segments • We call this process ray marching
